hypothesis: The repo's instruction surface (AGENTS.md + .github/copilot-instructions.md + .github/instructions/, ~65KB / ~16K tokens loaded into every session) is a net context tax on a small, well-scoped feature task. Removing it should reduce tool-result bytes and output tokens to first green, with turns roughly unchanged. NOTE: the verifier only checks the PR's own tests, so it CANNOT see policy compliance. A win here means 'cheaper to reach green', never 'instructions are not worth their cost'.

arms.description: Status quo: repo instruction surface present and untouched.
setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const need=['AGENTS.md','.github/copilot-instructions.md','.github/instructions'];const missing=need.filter(p=>!fs.existsSync(p));if(missing.length){console.error('control arm is not the status quo, missing: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"

arms.description: Instruction surface removed: no AGENTS.md, no copilot-instructions.md, no .github/instructions/. Skills and agent definitions are left intact so only one factor moves.
setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['AGENTS.md','.github/copilot-instructions.md'])fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});fs.rmSync('.github/instructions',{recursive:true,force:true});const left=['AGENTS.md','.github/copilot-instructions.md','.github/instructions'].filter(p=>fs.existsSync(p));if(left.length){console.error('trim did not take effect, still present: '+left.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
